name: Willow
overview: The Bible references willows both literally and figuratively, portraying them as symbols of life and flourishing near water, as seen in Isaiah 44:4 and Ezekiel 17:5 where willows grow by streams and fruitful fields. In Leviticus 23:40, willows are part of the joyous celebration before the Lord, highlighting their role in worship and remembrance. Psalms 137:2 uses willows as a poignant image of sorrow and exile, where the harps were hung upon them by the rivers of Babylon, reflecting deep mourning and longing for Zion.
